# Command Vehicle Assets (Sundered Isles)

## Flagship

*Fill in:* name  
*Track:* integrity meter: starts at 5, max 5; can be marked battered, cursed  
*Track:* supply (hold) meter: starts at 5, max 5; can be marked unequipped (hold)  
*Shared asset.*

- [x] Your seagoing flagship is armed with cannons, transports crew, cargo, and passengers, and can equip support vehicle and module assets. In addition, it has up to 5 hold that acts as supply for you and your allies when taking action or suffering a cost related to shipwide gear and provisions.
- [ ] When you Finish an Expedition (dangerous or greater) on a seagoing journey and score a hit, this expedition strengthened your ties to your ship and crew. You and your allies may mark 1 tick on your bonds legacy track.
- [ ] You fly a distinctive flag. Envision its design. Once per situation, when you hoist the colors in a dramatic moment, you and your allies take +1 momentum.
